prompts.name: base
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: attached original hero sprite atlas. Produce a production transparent RGBA sprite sheet, EXACT 4 columns x4 rows, same 16 poses in exactly same order and same silhouette/body proportions/face/hair/hand positions as the reference. This is the SAME brown tousled-haired boy, amber eyes, pale skin, little cream leaf hairpin, premium detailed pixel-art 2D platformer character. Change ONLY his outfit into a coherent elegant midnight-indigo NINJA set: cross-wrapped indigo cloth tunic, charcoal fitted pants, small slate segmented shoulder and forearm guards, silver piping, a muted teal sash, split-toe dark tabi boots with pale wraps, a long TWO-TAIL teal scarf instead of green cape. Keep his recognizable face fully visible, no face mask or hood, no logos. Clothing changes all sixteen poses including the two rear-view climbing poses. Unarmed throughout! No blades, no props, no action effects. Precisely retain the original hand/arm gestures and leg poses. Row1: idle, three running poses. Row2: jump tuck, falling arms open, landing crouch palm down, curled rolling pose. Row3: raised hand overhead attack anticipation, left arm extended punch slash, low forward followthrough, casting palm. Row4: unarmed bow aiming fists, throwing arm, rear-view climbing left knee raised, rear-view climbing right knee raised. Natural fabric folds and scarf tails respond differently to each pose. Each sprite separate with generous transparent gutters, no ground shadow/no grid/no text. Full body including hair and boots. Consistent character scale across all cells. Preserve transparency. Square atlas.
